newsitem.title: USA: Metromail files to issue shares for acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Metromail files to issue shares for acquisition.

text.p: Metromail Corp said Wednesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to issue up to 843,247 common shares for its acquisition of database company Atlantes Corp.

The filing includes notice of a special meeting of Atlantes shareholders, to be conducted as soon as possible after the registration statement becomes effective, to vote on the merger agreement and related issues.
The number of issued shares could be cut by up to 25 percent depending on whether Atlantes' holders choose to take part of the purchase price in cash.
Up to an additional $12.5 million in Metromail stock could be paid to Atlantes holders from 1999 to 2002, based on performance.

The acquisition, planned to close in the third quarter, is expected to have a neutral effect on Metromail earnings per share in 1997 and to add to earnings per share beginning in 1998, Metromail said.
